audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange rate formula `(cash + debt - cash_reserve) / total_supply` is protected because every donation path routes excess cash to `cash_reserve`: (1) `repay_amount` excess goes to `cash_reserve += repay - ceil(debt)` (L210), leaving the depositor numerator unchanged; (2) flash loan fees go through `increase_reserve_only` which increments both `cash` and `cash_reserve` identically (L291-292), netting zero delta on the rate; (3) `deposit_underlying` is private and only called by `mint_ctokens` (which issues proportional ctokens) and `repay_amount`. A first-depositor inflation attack via `repay_amount(huge)` with debt=0 causes `cash_reserve += huge` and `cash += huge`, so the rate numerator is unchanged, blocking the attack.
